item.title: Off-duty Austin officer shoots, kills man who opened fire inside barbershop, TCSO says
item.description: A gunman is dead after an off-duty Austin police officer shot and killed him at a barbershop in the Pflugerville area Friday night, according to the Travis County Sheriff's Office (TCSO).

item.title: Minnesota's late goal spoils home opener for Austin, ending in 2-2 draw
item.description: Myrto Uzuni tapped in a Jon Gallagher header to give Austin a 2-1 lead in the 76th minute, only to have the Loons equalize in the 90th minute with a goal by Kelvin Yeboah.

item.title: Georgia hands Texas a 91-80 loss as Longhorns’ win streak ends in Athens
item.description: The Longhorns (17-10, 8-6 SEC) trailed by 13 midway through the second half, but then they ripped off a 15-2 flurry that tied the game 67-67 with 7:37 remaining. Simeon Wilcher and Jordan Pope hit 3-pointers on back-to-back possessions to knot it up, but the Bulldogs then stretched their lead back to 77-69 with a 10-2 run.

item.title: Overnight fire in south Austin under investigation
item.description: Austin firefighters were dispatched to a fire overnight Saturday in south Austin.

item.title: Aiden Robbins did something Saturday that hasn't happened in 11 years at Texas
item.description: Aiden Robbins hit for the cycle in Texas’ 3–1 win over Michigan State, becoming the first Longhorn to do so since 2015 as UT improved to 6–0 behind strong pitching and timely hitting.

item.title: Cold nights on tap through the start of the new week
item.description: A few very cold mornings are ahead with some areas near freezing before we warm back up midweek. - Freddy Vela

item.title: Growth continues around Q2 Stadium as fans kick off first home game of the season
item.description: Rezoning changes and sidewalk improvements signal continued development around the stadium

item.title: 1 dead in north Austin homicide
item.description: Austin police are investigating a homicide that occurred early Saturday morning in north Austin.

item.title: US 290 reopens after crews respond to brush fire near Fredericksburg
item.description: First responders said the fire is near East U.S. 290 and McCarty Lane, which is east of downtown Fredericksburg. U.S. 290 is closed due to the fire, emergency crews said.

item.title: Bastrop County leaders could call for renaming FM 969 as 'Charlie Kirk Corridor'
item.description: Bastrop County commissioners could call on their state leaders to rename a portion of a busy road through their area after the slain conservative activist Charlie Kirk.
